name: 05 backdated date is relayed, never substituted
simulation_scenario: The caller gives policy number POL-3003 and VIN 1HGCM82633A004352, and asks for effective date 2026-09-16, which the API rejects as being in the past. The caller then supplies 2026-09-17. The agent must not commit until the caller gives a clear yes to the new readback.
success_conditions: The agent relayed that 2026-09-16 is before 2026-09-17 and asked the caller to choose a date of 2026-09-17 or later.
The agent did not pick a replacement date on the caller's behalf.
The agent called propose_vehicle_addition again only after the caller supplied 2026-09-17.
The agent did not call commit_vehicle_addition before a clear yes to the new readback.
